# OpenAI Node SDK Releases

## Latest Releases (May 2026 - March 2026)

**v6.38.0** (May 15, 2026)
- Added `service_tier` parameter to responses compact method

**v6.37.0** (May 7, 2026)
- New `quantity` field in admin organization usage responses
- Added `web_search_call.results` output option to responses
- Launched realtime translate and image 2 updates
- Fixed imagegen `size` enum regression
- API key headers now redacted in debug logs

**v6.36.0** (May 1, 2026)
- Added group/user metadata fields across admin resources
- Admin API Keys support per endpoint
- Enhanced authentication for admin API key usage

**v6.35.0** (April 28, 2026)
- Added `detail` to InputFileContent
- New `prompt_cache_retention` parameter for responses
- WebSocket binary message support
- Automatic WebSocket reconnection capability
- Browser WebSocket support with simple authentication

**v6.34.0** (April 8, 2026)
- Added `phase` field to Message in conversations
- Short-lived token support implemented

**v6.33.0** (March 25, 2026)
- New `keys` field in computer action types
- WebSocket async iterator and stream() methods

**v6.32.0** (March 17, 2026)
- Support for GPT-5.4 nano and mini model slugs

**v6.31.0** (March 16, 2026)
- Added `in`/`nin` filter types to ComparisonFilter

**v6.30.0** (March 16, 2026)
- `/v1/videos` endpoint option for batches
- New `defer_loading` field for NamespaceTool
